name: Black-Eyed Pea Stew
ingredients: 1 tsp smoked paprika and ½ tsp dried thyme
Black pepper, salt and a splash of vinegar
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 6 minutes. Add garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the peas and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale and cook for 5 minutes.
Finish with vinegar, pepper and salt.
note: A Southern-style stew: smoked paprika provides the smoky note without any meat.
